# Teespring (Spring)

> > Teespring (now Spring) is a print-on-demand e-commerce platform enabling creators and consumers to design, sell, and purchase custom apparel and merchandise with no minimum orders.

Spring operates both as a marketplace for discovering unique custom products and as Teespring Direct, a direct-to-consumer service for ordering personalized merchandise. The platform specializes in on-demand printing with free shipping options and comprehensive design tools.

## Key Topics

- Print-on-demand
- Custom apparel
- Teespring Direct
- No minimums
- Marketplace
- Custom merchandise
- Design tools
- Direct-to-consumer
- E-commerce platform
- Free shipping
- Product catalog
- On-demand printing
- Creator economy

## Print-on-Demand Services

- [Teespring Direct - Your Design. Made for you.](https://teespring.com/direct): Teespring Direct: print-on-demand service for custom apparel with no minimums

## Marketplace & Shopping

- [Teespring Marketplace](https://landingpage.teespring.com/): Teespring Marketplace landing page for browsing custom merchandise categories
- [Shop All Products](https://teespring.com/shop/shop-all): Complete catalog of all Spring/Teespring custom apparel and merchandise
- [New Products](https://teespring.com/shop/new): Latest arrivals and new custom products on Teespring marketplace
